product.olivetti-m4-64.summary: The 33 MHz DX M4 in the 305 Box chassis.
product.olivetti-m4-64.history: The M4 Modulo range targeted professionals and sat between the personal-use PCS and the higher-performance M6 Suprema. The guide identifies T.1 boards made in Singapore and Scarmagno.
product.olivetti-m4-64.architecture: The German brochure offered the M4-64 with 4 MB of RAM, 512 KB of video memory and 85/170/240 MB IDE disks. The guide documents T.1 and T.1.5 revisions, including the BA2077 shared with the other Modulo models in this series. OverDrive was an upgrade.
product.olivetti-m4-64.verified: The configuration was checked against the cited sources. BluMach validation is pending.
product.olivetti-m4-64.limitations: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
product.olivetti-m4-64.service-guide: Olivetti, Personal Computer – Pocket Service Guide, vol. II, ch. 2
product.olivetti-m4-64.firmware: The guide lists BIOS 2.06 as the last BA2077 service revision. A dump for this model still needs to be confirmed and tested at its factory clock.
